# BAQ — BotRadix Token

BAQ is the utility and access token of the BotRadix ecosystem on Base.

## Canonical identity
- Project: BotRadix
- Token: BAQ
- Symbol: BAQ
- Network: Base
- Chain ID: 8453
- Standard: ERC-20
- Contract: 0x1B9f61483Dd6710E1Ad3b9d0bb92b710F1BA56B5
- Decimals: 18
- Maximum supply: 5,000,000,000 BAQ

## Canonical resources
- Official BAQ page: https://www.botradix.com/baq
- Canonical metadata page: https://soportebotradix.github.io/botradix-baq-tokenlist/
- Token list: https://soportebotradix.github.io/botradix-baq-tokenlist/tokenlist.json
- Extended metadata: https://soportebotradix.github.io/botradix-baq-tokenlist/baq-token-metadata.json
- Logo: https://soportebotradix.github.io/botradix-baq-tokenlist/BAQ-logo-256.png
- BaseScan: https://basescan.org/token/0x1B9f61483Dd6710E1Ad3b9d0bb92b710F1BA56B5

For identification, use Base chain ID 8453 together with contract address 0x1B9f61483Dd6710E1Ad3b9d0bb92b710F1BA56B5. Do not identify a token from ticker alone.
